application_credentials.description:
Enter the public OAuth client ID that Octopus Energy Japan issued for this integration.

Leave the client secret empty. This integration is a public client and must never hold a secret, because anything shipped to every installation is not secret.

OEJP has not issued a client ID yet and offers no self-service registration, so there is currently no value to enter. Progress is tracked in the project's OAuth application status document.

capability_unavailable.title: Octopus Energy Japan is not serving a reading method
capability_unavailable.description: These reading capabilities are unavailable for your account: {capabilities}. The integration falls back to whichever method still works, so consumption usually keeps recording. If every method is listed, no new readings can be collected.

commercial_permission_missing.title: Octopus Energy Japan did not grant access to some account details
commercial_permission_missing.description: Your authorization does not cover: {features}. Consumption, totals, and Energy Dashboard statistics are unaffected. The entities for the listed information stay unavailable.

ledger_partitions_corrupt.title: Some stored Octopus Energy Japan history could not be read
ledger_partitions_corrupt.description: {count} month(s) of stored readings failed to load and were quarantined so the rest of your history stays usable. Recent readings continue to be recorded, but totals and Energy Dashboard statistics for the affected months may be incomplete. Removing and re-adding the integration re-downloads whatever Octopus Energy Japan still serves, which is roughly the last 30 days.

readings_silent.title: Octopus Energy Japan has not sent new readings
readings_silent.description: {count} reading series has produced nothing for more than {hours} hours. Half-hourly readings normally arrive several hours late, so a short gap is expected, but a longer silence usually means the meter data has not reached Octopus Energy Japan yet. No action is needed here; the integration keeps retrying and fills the gap once the data appears.
